in_sanskrit.name: Nikku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nikku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Niketanam’, which means ‘place of victory’. In Hindu mythology, Nikku is a name associated with gods and warriors. It is believed that the name instills courage, strength, and determination.
